Use your home network or a lab network. If you cannot run commands, use
**Terminal Lab** in the place "Office (cable)".

way to the Internet. (1 mark)

b) Run `ipconfig` and `ping` to your gateway and to `example.com`. Write

## Task 2 · A player with lag (3 marks)

A player of an online racing game sends these outputs:

```
C:\> ping 192.168.0.1
Average = 3ms, Lost = 0 (0% loss)
C:\> ping race.example.org
Reply: time=41ms   Reply: time=190ms
Request timed out. Reply: time=44ms
Lost = 1 (25% loss)
C:\> tracert race.example.org
  1    3 ms  192.168.0.1
  2   10 ms  10.40.0.1
  3   12 ms  203.0.113.20
  4  150 ms  203.0.113.88
  5  155 ms  198.51.100.40
```

a) Is the home network (the LAN and the Wi-Fi) the problem? Explain with
the numbers. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) Where does the delay start? What do jitter and loss tell you? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

c) Which protocol should the game use for the positions of the cars, and
which one for buying a new car? Why? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}
